# Data {#sec-data}

{{< include _caution.qmd >}}

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
library(peekbankr)
library(here)
i_am("notebooks/01-data.qmd")  # _quarto.yml would otherwise make notebooks/ the root

RELEASE <- "2026.1"
CACHE <- here("cache", "01_peekbank_novel.rds")
```

We pull all metadata tables, find every dataset that has a novel word as a target or
distractor stimulus, and download the AOI timepoints only for those datasets.
The result is cached in `cache/`, which is gitignored. Delete the cache file to force a fresh pull.
This requires a `REDIVIS_API_TOKEN` with the `data.metadata` scope.

```{r}
#| label: pull
if (!file.exists(CACHE)) {
  pb <- peekbank(RELEASE)

  meta <- list(
    datasets = pb$datasets,
    subjects = pb$subjects,
    administrations = pb$administrations,
    trials = pb$trials,
    trial_types = pb$trial_types,
    stimuli = pb$stimuli
  )

  novel_datasets <- meta$stimuli |>
    filter(stimulus_novelty == "novel") |>
    distinct(dataset_name) |>
    pull(dataset_name)

  aoi <- pb$subset$aoi_timepoints(dataset_name %in% !!novel_datasets)

  saveRDS(c(meta, list(aoi_timepoints = aoi, novel_datasets = novel_datasets,
                       release = RELEASE)),
          CACHE)
}

d <- readRDS(CACHE)
stopifnot(d$release == RELEASE)
```

## Datasets with novel words

```{r}
#| label: novel-datasets
novel_summary <- d$administrations |>
  filter(dataset_name %in% d$novel_datasets) |>
  group_by(dataset_name) |>
  summarise(n_subjects = n_distinct(subject_id),
            n_admins = n(),
            min_age = min(age, na.rm = TRUE),
            max_age = max(age, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  left_join(d$datasets |> select(dataset_name, shortcite), by = "dataset_name") |>
  relocate(shortcite, .after = dataset_name)

novel_summary
```

Not all of these are novel-word *learning* datasets. Two code mispronunciations as "novel"
(`swingley_aslin_2002`, `moore_bergelson_2022_verb`); they are excluded in @sec-exposure.

## Full citations

```{r}
#| label: citations
d$datasets |>
  filter(dataset_name %in% d$novel_datasets) |>
  select(dataset_name, cite)
```

## Timepoint data

```{r}
#| label: aoi-summary
d$aoi_timepoints |>
  left_join(d$administrations |> select(administration_id, dataset_name),
            by = "administration_id") |>
  group_by(dataset_name) |>
  summarise(n_admins = n_distinct(administration_id),
            n_trials = n_distinct(trial_id),
            n_samples = n())
```
